visualization_settings.text: How has the precipitation probabilities changed?

stages.native:
SELECT
	date_day,
	min_temperature,
	avg_temperature,
	max_temperature
FROM wdp.week_weather_report
WHERE is_current = 1;

SELECT
	date_day,
	min_precip_prob,
	avg_precip_prob,
	max_precip_prob
FROM wdp.week_weather_report
WHERE is_current = 1;

SELECT
	date_day,
	forecast_t_minus_2,
	forecast_t_minus_1,
	current_forecast
FROM (
	SELECT
		date_day,
		LAG(min_temperature, 2) OVER(PARTITION BY date_day ORDER BY is_current) AS forecast_t_minus_2,
		LAG(min_temperature, 1) OVER(PARTITION BY date_day ORDER BY is_current) AS forecast_t_minus_1,
		min_temperature AS current_forecast,
		is_current
	FROM wdp.week_weather_report
) AS t1
WHERE is_current = 1;

SELECT
	date_day,
	forecast_t_minus_2,
	forecast_t_minus_1,
	current_forecast
FROM (
	SELECT
		date_day,
		LAG(avg_temperature, 2) OVER(PARTITION BY date_day ORDER BY is_current) AS forecast_t_minus_2,
		LAG(avg_temperature, 1) OVER(PARTITION BY date_day ORDER BY is_current) AS forecast_t_minus_1,
		avg_temperature AS current_forecast,
		is_current
	FROM wdp.week_weather_report
) AS t1
WHERE is_current = 1;

SELECT
	date_day,
	forecast_t_minus_2,
	forecast_t_minus_1,
	current_forecast
FROM (
	SELECT
		date_day,
		LAG(max_temperature, 2) OVER(PARTITION BY date_day ORDER BY is_current) AS forecast_t_minus_2,
		LAG(max_temperature, 1) OVER(PARTITION BY date_day ORDER BY is_current) AS forecast_t_minus_1,
		max_temperature AS current_forecast,
		is_current
	FROM wdp.week_weather_report
) AS t1
WHERE is_current = 1;

SELECT
	date_day,
	forecast_t_minus_2,
	forecast_t_minus_1,
	current_forecast
FROM (
	SELECT
		date_day,
		LAG(min_precip_prob, 2) OVER(PARTITION BY date_day ORDER BY is_current) AS forecast_t_minus_2,
		LAG(min_precip_prob, 1) OVER(PARTITION BY date_day ORDER BY is_current) AS forecast_t_minus_1,
		min_precip_prob AS current_forecast,
		is_current
	FROM wdp.week_weather_report
) AS t1
WHERE is_current = 1;

SELECT
	CONCAT(temperature, '°C (', temp_categorized, ')')
FROM wdp.today_weather_report
WHERE is_current = 1 AND hour_ < TO_CHAR((CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'), 'HH24:MI')
ORDER BY hour_ DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
	CONCAT(precip_prob, '% (', precip_prob_categorized, ')')
FROM wdp.today_weather_report
WHERE is_current = 1 AND hour_ < TO_CHAR((CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'America/Denver'), 'HH24:MI')
ORDER BY hour_ DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
	hour_,
	temperature
FROM wdp.today_weather_report
WHERE is_current = 1;

SELECT
	hour_,
	precip_prob
FROM wdp.today_weather_report
WHERE is_current = 1;

SELECT
	hour_,
	forecast_t_minus_2,
	forecast_t_minus_1,
	current_forecast
FROM (
	SELECT
		hour_,
		LAG(temperature, 2) OVER(PARTITION BY hour_ ORDER BY valid_to) AS forecast_t_minus_2,
		LAG(temperature, 1) OVER(PARTITION BY hour_ ORDER BY valid_to) AS forecast_t_minus_1,
		temperature AS current_forecast,
		is_current
	FROM wdp.today_weather_report
) AS t1
WHERE is_current = 1;
